case_101.label_scope: One fixed implementation over the full public domain; inputs only supply witnesses.
case_101.analysis: All 63,488 finite FP16 encodings compared with directed mathematical intervals in multiple orders and offsets. Other N/tails, input guards and fresh output are checked separately. Scalar coverage is not exhaustive GPU execution coverage.

oracle.scope: Directed mathematical intervals supply the oracle; mpmath agreement is an independent numerical cross-check. Exhaustive scalar encodings are separate from tensor indexing and GPU specialization checks.
oracle.method: Direct MPFR real cbrt with RoundDown and RoundUp; outward binary64 endpoints. Independent mpmath real cube root crosschecks every finite FP16 encoding.
oracle.independence: No candidate exponent splitting, polynomial coefficients, Newton iteration, remainder constants or FP32 reconstruction is used by the oracle.

indexing.argument: For index=program_id*BLOCK+lane, adjacent blocks cover disjoint adjacent intervals. mask index<N retains [0,N) exactly once. The full legal N range has 1..BLOCK active lanes in its last block, with int32-safe address indices.
indexing.scope: Arithmetic model of the audited source indexing, not exhaustive GPU testing of every N, address, or compiler specialization.

cpu_audit.scope: Exhaustive FP16 domain reference audit, separate from GPU arithmetic qualification.
